title: {{NAME}} and the Robot Who Fixed the Princess's Dinosaur
moral: Using your special skills to help others is always worthwhile.

pages.content: {{NAME}} walked up to a castle on top of a hill. The castle had a big moat and tall towers. In the courtyard, a princess sat next to her pet dinosaur. The dinosaur was very sad. His tail drooped on the ground. A small silver robot stood nearby with tools.

pages.content: {{NAME}} went into the courtyard. 'What happened?' asked {{NAME}}. 'My dinosaur hurt his tail,' said the princess. 'I do not know how to help him.' The robot beeped. 'I can fix this,' said the robot. {{NAME}} and the princess looked at the robot with hope.

pages.content: The robot got to work. It scanned the dinosaur's tail with a blue light. It pulled out a soft bandage and wrapped the tail carefully. The robot sang a soft little song while it worked. {{NAME}} helped hold the bandage. The dinosaur kept very still.

pages.content: The dinosaur's tail wiggled. Then it wagged. The dinosaur stood up and did a big happy stomp. The whole courtyard shook. The princess cheered and hugged the robot. Then she hugged {{NAME}}. 'We fixed him together!' said the princess.

pages.content: That evening, {{NAME}}, the princess, and the robot sat on the castle steps. The dinosaur lay beside them like a big warm hill. The stars came out bright and clear. {{NAME}} leaned on the dinosaur and felt very happy. Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Sleep well. Tomorrow, the robot says it has built something brand new just for you.
